root_cause: The bridge atomically replaces bytes but does not atomically claim the immutable final pathname. The path.exists check is a time-of-check/time-of-use gap, and os.replace deliberately overwrites an existing destination.
causal_chain: Two Host submitters validate different results for the same execution ID.
Both can observe that result.json does not exist.
Each calls os.replace against result.json; the second overwrites the first.
The durable result no longer proves first-writer single assignment.
rejected_hypotheses: A sequential exists check is sufficient; it does not serialize concurrent publishers.
os.replace fails when the target exists; by design it replaces the target.
A process-local lock is sufficient; different Host wrapper processes would not share it.
